    Class FeatureQuery

    Handles spatial feature queries (point hit-testing, bbox selection). Extracted from Emap to keep the map class focused on coordination.

    clear

    • clear(sourceId?: string): void

      Drop cached spatial indexes for one source (or all). Necessary after in-place geometry edits (translateSelected, vertex commands) that mutate arc coordinates without changing shape / arc counts — without this call, the cache key wouldn't notice and queries would return prefilter-stale results.

      Parameters

      • OptionalsourceId: string

        sourceId accepts string for clear. Optional; omit to leave unset. Must be assignable to string.

      Returns void

      • Defined in src/map/feature-query.ts:97

    prebuild

    • prebuild(sourceId?: string): void

      Eagerly build spatial indexes for every layer of one source (or all sources when omitted). Idempotent — already-cached entries are skipped. Used by Emap.prebuildSpatialIndex to pay the build cost in idle time before the first user query.

      Parameters

      • OptionalsourceId: string

        sourceId accepts string for prebuild. Optional; omit to leave unset. Must be assignable to string.

      Returns void
